file_change.purpose: Define the minimum durable semantic-review evidence representation used by FS0 Planning and Build acceptance.
implementation: Define Draft 2020-12 JSON schema for Assurance report identity, phase, subject, exact artifact revision, reviewer/actor identity, disposition pass/fail, required review criteria, findings, rationale, and evidence references.
Keep case findings non-normative and require explicit routing target when disposition fails because upstream correction is needed.
